issues.description: All production rates are placeholders; masking/protection variability is high in new construction.
issues.suggested_fix: Calibrate with field logs and add selection rules for when masking is required based on application_method and environment.

issues.description: Primer systems are generic (no product SKUs) and quality_level mapping uses three systems primarily for discipline.
issues.suggested_fix: Once Material DB exists, map SYS_* systems to products and refine spread rates by product line.

issues.description: Backroll task inclusion should be enforced by application_method selection logic to prevent accidental inclusion on spray-only.
issues.suggested_fix: Ensure runtime selection rules include TSK_BACKROLL_PRIMER_R2 only when application_method = spray_backroll.

summary: Spec structure correctly models priming workflow as walls+ceilings together with finish coats excluded. Modularity and task rounds exist; rates require calibration before approval.
review_notes: Good separation between prime workflow and finish specs.
Dust control and fuzzing mitigation are explicitly modeled.
Environment dimension captured to manage protection burden.
